decision: Selected the latitude and longitude that Laramie County's SmartGov parcel layer publishes for parcel 12660510000400 (account R0069429; Tract 2, Record of Survey for Switchgrass Industrial Park, portion of Sec 5 T12N R66W; 525.26 net acres; owner Cheyenne Power Hub LLC; zone PUD) as the campus locator for the Project Jade data-centre campus. The county's address register assigns 210 US 85 (remarks 'PROJECT JADE', use COMMERCIAL-MULTI, assigned 2026-01-30) to the same parcel. The published parcel point coincides with the polygon's planar centroid (1.1 m) and lies inside it.
